contexts.text: A topaz, etc. () = the celestial love of good; for these stones = the good of celestial love, from their red and flaming colour; here, celestial love, because they were in the first row. Explained.
It is not known from what word the topaz is derived: it is probable that it was derived from a reddish flaming colour; and hence it is that the like is said of it as of gold, in .
